decisions.evidence: Taken together, the molecule’s low lipophilicity, multiple hydroxyl groups, and absence of the weakly basic lipophilic profile commonly linked to SARS-CoV-2 replication inhibition make it more consistent with option (A): does not inhibit SARS-CoV-2 replication.
The final prediction is therefore option (A): does not inhibit SARS-CoV-2 replication.
